notice.occasion.failed.label: A download fails
notice.occasion.failed.note: Nothing to do but look, so the system is told.
notice.occasion.finished.label: A download finishes
notice.occasion.finished.note: The dialog opens it, shows it, or brings the window back.
notice.occasion.queue.label: Every download finishes
notice.occasion.queue.note: Off, or the last of a batch says it twice.
notice.occasion.update.label: A newer build is found
notice.occasion.update.note: The card in the corner is where it is installed from.
settings.label.dim: Dim the window when it is not in front
settings.note.automatic_updates: Acts on what the check finds without asking.
settings.note.check_for_updates: Every five minutes, and once at launch.
settings.note.colorful: The sidebar's icons keep their hues always.
settings.note.column_widths: Every column back to where it started.
settings.note.connections: Parts to fetch a file in; empty is the engine's own.
settings.note.dim: Off keeps its colors whether in front or not.
settings.note.dns_how: Port 53 is in the clear; over HTTPS is not.
settings.note.dns_what: The system knows your hosts file and your VPN; Hickory knows what it is told.
settings.note.dns_who: The machine's own servers, or the ones named below.
settings.note.download_folder: The folder this system calls Downloads.
settings.note.folders: Nothing moves on disk; this is how it reads.
settings.note.hide_junk: System leavings and scratch files. Torrents still show under Torrents.
settings.note.http_version: Which version to ask the server for.
settings.note.language: What the window is read in. Takes effect at once.
settings.note.latest_build: What the last check came to.
settings.note.on_completion: Nothing yet; a finished file is left where it landed.
settings.note.preallocate: Claims the size up front, so a full disk is found early.
settings.note.proxy_source: The address a proxy listens on is its choice, so the machine is asked.
settings.note.show_with: What shows a file where it lives.
settings.note.speed_limit: Across every download at once, not each.
settings.note.start_at_login: Opens with the machine, where the system keeps its login items.
settings.note.user_agent: Some servers hand a download manager a different file, or none.
